moats: Leading-Edge Foundry Monopoly (<3nm / 2nm): Commands >90% market share in sub-3nm nodes, with N2 GAA nanosheet progressing ahead of schedule with superior commercial yields.
Turnkey Advanced Packaging Dominance (CoWoS / SoIC): TSMC's 3D Fabric platform creates an unbeatable ecosystem barrier for AI accelerators (Nvidia Blackwell/Rubin, AMD MI350).
Unrivaled Sovereign Pricing Power & Switching Costs: 5-10% annual wafer price increases on leading nodes with >65% gross margins and prohibitive client redesign costs (>$500M).

competitive_moats.title: Leading-Edge Foundry Monopoly (<3nm / 2nm)
competitive_moats.description: Commands >90% market share in sub-3nm nodes, with N2 GAA nanosheet progressing ahead of schedule with superior commercial yields.

competitive_moats.title: Turnkey Advanced Packaging Dominance (CoWoS / SoIC)
competitive_moats.description: TSMC's 3D Fabric platform creates an unbeatable ecosystem barrier for AI accelerators (Nvidia Blackwell/Rubin, AMD MI350).

competitive_moats.title: Unrivaled Sovereign Pricing Power & Switching Costs
competitive_moats.description: 5-10% annual wafer price increases on leading nodes with >65% gross margins and prohibitive client redesign costs (>$500M).

catalysts: AI Datacenter Capex Super-Cycle: Global cloud giants deploying >$200B in annual capex funneled directly into TSMC silicon.
High-Margin N3P/N3E Node Expansion: Universal adoption across Apple, Nvidia, AMD, Qualcomm, and MediaTek.
Overseas Fab Yield Maturation: Fab 21 in Arizona and JASM Kumamoto reaching commercial parity, easing geopolitical concentration concerns and unlocking >$15B in government grants.
Institutional Short-Covering & Mean-Reversion: Multiple compression exhausted at 56th percentile PER after -239K lots foreign selling, triggering violent institutional short-covering.

stop_loss.description: Strict risk cut-off set 2.0% below the panic low wick of NT$ 2,020 reached on 2026-11-06.

thesis_breakers: Quarterly gross margin dropping below 60.0% (indicating loss of pricing power or severe fab dilution).
Cancellation or scale-back of CoWoS capacity commitments by major AI accelerator customers.
Punitive trade tariffs (>25%) enacted by the US Department of Commerce on Taiwan foundry exports.
